description.text: School of Finance is famous with a long history in and out of Jiangsu province, includes Financial Department, Risk Management, Insurance Department, and other teaching institutes. Now it has four major specialities. They are Finance, Insurance, Credit Management, and Investment Science. Finance is the key disciplinary area of Jiangsu province. Insurance is a marked speciality constructed by Nanjing Audit University. The Finance Library is the central demonstration construction of finance experimental teaching of Jiangsu province and also it is a superior subject project constructed by central and local governments. It consists of Finance Department, Risk Management Department, Insurance Department and other teaching, administrative and research organizations. Among the 40 teachers, there are around 30 professors and associate professors, and more than 10 PhDs. In recent years, over 300 theses have been published in such authoritative journal as Financial Research, Insurance Research, Trends in Economics, Eco-comics in Finance and Trade, Quantity Economy and Technical Economy Research. Around 40 treatises and textbooks have come out. The school has engaged in ministerial and provincial research projects and won more than 20 teaching and research awards. B.A. Investment Objectives: The Investment specialty aims to educate students with a high quality of professional knowledge to meet the need of the construction of the socialist market economy and the need of many other fields concerned with investment. Graduates are fit for jobs in investment cooperation, stockjobber, bank, insurance agent, fund Management Company, etc. Object: Four-year Bachelor of Economics Degree Main courses: Political Economy, Macro-Economics, Micro-Economics, Econometrics, Monetary and Banking, International Finance, Accounting, Management, Fiscal Science, Insurance, Investment Science, International Investment, Investment in Enterprise, Public Investment, Risk Investment, Investment Projects Assessment, Securities Investment Analysis, Investment Fund Management, Investment Banking, Project Financing, Investment Projects Management, Real Estate Investment, Option and Futures, Information System of Investment Management, etc.

duration.text: The Investment Science at Nanjing Audit University is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 2222 USD/per year ￥ 16000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2. Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3. HSK Certificate (No need for English-taught program) Level 3or above 4. Academic transcript of high school 5. Graduation certificate of high school Gradution certificate should be in Chinese or English.If not,it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized.

requirements.text: Applicant is under the age of 25, and is in good health, high-school graduate with good marks. The HSK score should reach level 3 or above
